targets.outcome_computational_quote:
In general, we were able to reproduce Alvarez et al.’s major empirical results, except
with minor discrepancies in the statistics involving simulations.
targets.outcome_robustness_quote:
These changes are noticeable and important as
they directly translate into smaller CIR in an 1-to-1 scale.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The major results were reproduced with explicitly minor numerical discrepancies, compatible with the computation category. Some additional parameters and figures were unrecovered, leaving uncertainty about aggregation. Alternative outlier criteria materially reduce the policy response.
